[ #memecoins as a Legit Asset Class ]

For the first time, meme coins are recognized as legitimate in crypto. 

Institutional interest could turn meme coins into an asset class over the next 10-20 years, with multi-cycle survivors like @dogecoin and @RealFlokiInu as examples

[ Emergence of #memecoins ]

#memecoins gained traction as a social phenomenon, starting with #Dogecoin in 2013. 

Over time, their popularity grew due to social media influence and cultural trends, with the current cycle seeing millions of meme coins
